verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 110.8 (+2.1% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 1,000, 85s 2,500 and 86s 6,000. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-25T17:31:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell João Félix 84 Team of the week after its 17% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 224,000 coins. Now 190,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 16.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +8.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 6,000 (1.46 coins per Item Score point), 87s 8,600 (1.56 coins per Item Score point), 88s 15,500 (1.87 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Tahith Chong and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Tahith Chong 85 Ultimate Scream -69.5%; Junior Alonso 85 Ultimate Scream -61.9%; Selina Vobian 86 Ultimate Scream -59.0%; Serhou Guirassy 86 Star Performer -58.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Assane Diao SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 55.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
